documents.title: Bambu PLA Translucent Technical Data Sheet V3.0
Bambu PLA Translucent Safety Data Sheet (SDS20250928A17)
Bambu PLA Translucent Hex Code Table
Filament guide: printer, nozzle, AMS and build plate compatibility

notes: TDS values with no registry key (not stored as specs): Melt Index 4.08 ± 1.5 g/10 min (210 °C, 2.16 kg); Crystallization Temperature "/"; Saturated Water Absorption Rate 0.34% (25 °C, 55% RH); Young's Modulus X-Y 2880 ± 190 MPa, Z 2550 ± 150 MPa (ISO 527, GB/T 1040); all Z-direction mechanical values (in each spec's note).

TDS recommended settings with no registry key: Printing and Storage Humidity < 20% RH (Sealed, with desiccant); Bed Surface Preparation: Glue; Retraction Length 0.6 - 1.0 mm; Retraction Speed 20 - 40 mm/s; Max Overhang Angle 55°; Max Bridging Length 30 mm; Support Material: Support for PLA; annealing 50 to 60 °C for 6 to 12 hours (p.3).

TDS p.3 Other Physical and Chemical Properties (no registry keys): Odorless; Skin Hazards: No hazard; Insoluble in water; not resistant to acid, alkali and some organic solvents; resistant to most oil and grease; Flammable; combustion products water and carbon oxides.

SDS (SDS20250928A17): not classified under (EC) No 1272/2008; transport (IMDG, DOT, ADR/RID, ICAO/IATA): Not hazardous goods; section 9 gives no density, melting point or other physical data ("No data available."). No registry key carries these.

Store page consistency: diameter 1.75 mm, tolerance ± 0.03 mm and net weight 1 kg agree with the payload rows; "available in 10 vibrant colors" matches the 10 colour values and the 10 hex rows. The only disagreement among official sources is 0.2 mm nozzles (TDS lists 0.2 mm; store FAQ and PLA wiki exclude 0.2 mm stainless steel), recorded as a conflict_note.

Not read (not cached, offline): the store page's Filament RoHS PDF (https://store.bblcdn.com/s7/default/369b7d0c17804f9d8a4402a121dd8d1d/Bambu_PLA_Translucent_RoHS.pdf) and its printing-tips wiki link (https://wiki.bambulab.com/en/knowledge-sharing/transparent-petg). safety.certifications is therefore neither a value nor not_published.
